name: Aluminum Small base Quad Canes
full_description: Small base design allows for a faster pace; large base design gives more stability at a slower pace. Quad canes stand up on their own. Available with contoured vinyl hand grips or foam handles. Canes with four feet allow for greater weight-bearing and stability than single-point canes. Non-skid rubber tips on all four feet ensure long life.

name: OFFSET HANDLE FASHION CRANES
full_description: Offset handle design provides natural wrist position and reduces strain. Available in multiple colors and styles. Adjustable height for proper fitting. Perfect for daily use and mobility support.

name: BARIATRIC QUAD CANES
full_description: Heavy-duty construction designed for users requiring extra weight capacity. Features reinforced base and extra-wide feet for stability. Non-slip rubber tips. Durable construction for long-term use.

name: LUMEX TALL ADULT CRUTCHES
full_description: Designed for tall individuals requiring crutches. Lightweight aluminum construction. Contoured armpit pads and hand grips for comfort. Adjustable height to fit various body types. Non-slip rubber tips on feet.

name: 3-IN-1 all purpose COMMODE
full_description: Three-in-one design functions as toilet seat, bedside commode, and shower chair. Sturdy steel frame construction. Easy to assemble and disassemble. Removable seat for easy cleaning. Ideal for elderly and disabled individuals.
